# GitHub repository metadata — suggested values

The **GitHub About panel** is maintained through GitHub repository settings; committing this file does not modify those settings.

**Suggested short description** (under GitHub's 350-character limit):

> Research framework for evaluating machine unlearning against multi-seed exact retraining. Reproducible diagnostics, immutable evidence, and honest pilot-stage limitations.

**Suggested homepage URL:**

> https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23540870

That homepage points to the **pilot preprint**, not the project software release. Leaving the homepage blank is also reasonable if the software repo itself is the canonical entry point.

**Suggested GitHub topics** (use as individual lower-case topics):

`machine-unlearning`, `machine-learning`, `reproducible-research`, `exact-retraining`, `counterfactual-evaluation`, `ml-benchmark`, `privacy-evaluation`, `pytorch`, `research-software`, `experimental-methodology`

Avoid `verified-unlearning`, `production-ready`, `peer-reviewed`, `open-source`, or `certified-privacy`; those claims are not substantiated or conflict with the current license.

**Suggested release tag after verification:** `v0.5.1` (software). **Do not** confuse it with benchmark protocol `0.5.0` or preprint DOI.
